firm_data.firm_description: Underberg & Kessler LLP is a full-service law firm rooted in Rochester, New York, with offices in Buffalo, Canandaigua, and Geneseo. The firm provides legal counsel to businesses, municipalities, not-for-profit organizations, and individuals throughout Western New York and across the state.
notable_facts: Has offices in Rochester, Buffalo, Canandaigua, and Geneseo.

email.subject: AI for Underberg & Kessler LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Patrick,

With roots going back to 1926, Underberg & Kessler has built something most firms never achieve: genuine regional reach across four offices while maintaining the trust clients expect. That model works, but it demands efficiency.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the Northeast to meet firms managing complex work across Banking & Corporate. I'd be happy to stop by your Rochester office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
